name: airflow-digitador-sinan
description: Airflow + Docker ETL pipeline: REDCap extraction, SINAN processing, RPA automation

explore.description: Explore DAGs, ETL scripts, API, and RPA codebase (fast, read-only)

sinan-etl.description: Specialist for ETL pipeline: REDCap extraction, carga scripts, database migrations

sinan-rpa.description: Specialist for RPA automation: PyAutoGUI, OpenCV, SINAN desktop navigation

sinan-devops.description: Specialist for Docker/Airflow operations: compose, init, deploy, monitoring

deploy.description: Deploy or update production: git pull, submodule update, docker compose restart
deploy.prompt: Follow the production deployment guide at projects/sinan/Documentacao/guia_deploy_producao.md. Steps: 1) SSH into server 2) cd airflow_digitador_sinan 3) git pull origin main 4) git submodule update --remote 5) Configure .env if missing 6) docker compose up -d

reset-db.description: Reset sinan_api database: drop, recreate, run migrations, seed initial data
reset-db.prompt: 1) docker compose down 2) docker compose rm -f postgres_sinan 3) docker volume rm airflow-docker_sinan_pgdata 4) docker compose up -d postgres_sinan 5) Wait for healthcheck 6) cd projects/sinan/2_digitador_sinan_api 7) alembic upgrade head 8) Run carga_violencia.py to seed data

carga.description: Run carga script for a specific agravo (default: violencia)
carga.prompt: Run one of the carga scripts in projects/sinan/2_digitador_sinan_api/: carga_violencia.py, carga_sifilis.py, carga_toxoplasmose.py, carga_toxoplasmose_gestacional.py, carga_varicela.py, carga_zika.py, carga_creutzfeldt_jakob.py
